name: On Hit
description: Fires when any of your effects damages an enemy.

name: On Kill
description: Fires when any enemy dies to your effects.

name: On Pickup
description: Fires when you collect fuel or XP.

name: On Crit
description: Fires when a hit crits. Scales with crit investment.

name: On Dash
description: Fires when you dash. Makes mobility a build axis.

name: On Wound
description: Fires when you take damage. Pairs with Leech.

name: On Wave
description: Fires when a wave arrives. The burst archetype.

name: On Overheat
description: Fires when Heat hits 100. Weaponises the penalty.

name: On Convert
description: Fires when a conversion resolves. Economy-engine builds.
